title: 第7章 学魔法没有前途的第8章 熔兵手
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
在魔力彻底‘稳定’下来后，达里安开始正式教导安东学习魔法。
对安东这个拥有超魔体质、潜力巨大的学生，达里安教导起来堪称尽心尽力，倾囊相授。
只可惜安东的心思根本不在魔法上面。
要不是没有合适的理由拒绝，他甚至不打算在魔法上浪费半点时间。
究其本质，魔法只是一种能量应用技巧，是对法则之力的粗浅模仿。
施法者穷尽一生研习魔法，终极目标也不过是触及法则的门槛。
可修仙大道本身便直指天地法则，如果是为了理解法则，安东何必舍近求远？
即便要学习能量应用技巧作为过渡，术法也毫无疑问比魔法更值得投入精力。
魔力与灵气的能量密度差距，已足以证明二者威能的悬殊差距。
更何况术法之上，还有神通。
移山填海、摘星拿月，那才是真正的大逍遥、大自在。
无论从哪方面看，修仙体系的术法神通都更胜一筹。
学魔法没有前途的。
尽管以他炼气初期的修为尚不能修习术法，但武技同样不比魔法逊色，更值得倾注心血。
好在学习魔法本身就需要花费大量时间研究符文模型，进行施法实践，只有遇到疑难才需请教老师。
大部分时候，安东还是比较自由的。
平日上课时认真学习，其他时候便专心炼化灵气、研究符箓、修炼武技。
他私底下已打听清楚，银月森林外围布置了三层警戒体系：歌鸟、哨兵树与活体荆棘。
歌鸟是拳头大小的翠羽鸣禽，会在发现陌生外来生物时发出特定频率的鸣叫，森林卫队手里有专门的工具可以接收歌鸟发出的声音，从而得知外人入侵。
活体荆棘则是深埋地下的魔法植物，平时隐于落叶腐土之下，一旦感应到异常震动或气息，便会如毒蛇般暴起，缠绕连接形成高达数米的藤墙。

那些布满倒刺的藤蔓坚韧如铁，且带有麻痹毒素，足以让入侵者在挣扎中失去反抗之力。
如果敌人能突破活体荆棘，接下来要面对的就是哨兵树。
这些活化树木的战斗力不如橡木守卫，但胜在数量多，每一头都有白位下游的战力，堪比大部分城镇守军的精锐士兵，许多时候都能成功拦下敌人，为卫队赶来争取时间。
正是靠着这层防御网，森林卫队多次成功拦截和击退蜥蜴人的入侵。
安东如果想离开银月森林，同样要面对这层天罗地网。
好在他已有大致对策。
“匿息符隐藏气息，遁形符隐藏身形，身法类武技降低赶路动静……嗯，再配上一张轻身符更稳妥点。”
安东暗暗盘算。
有了这些手段，应该可以悄无声息地穿过警戒网，离开银月森林。
不过在此之前，还要发育一段时间。
毕竟鳞岩蜥怎么说也是龙兽，不好对付，最好等炼化多一口灵气，再掌握几门武技，积攒多一些符箓之后，再去狩猎更为妥当。
这也算是刻在骨子里的玩家本能了，下副本前不把技能点满、物资备足，总觉得没有安全感。
content_en:
After the magic power was completely 'stabilized', Darien began to formally teach Anton how to learn magic.
For Anton, a student with a super-magic physique and huge potential, Darien taught him with all his heart and soul.
It's a pity that Anton's mind is not on magic at all.
If he didn't have a suitable reason to refuse, he wouldn't even waste any time on magic.
Ultimately, magic is just an energy application technique, a crude imitation of the power of law.
Spellcasters spend their entire lives studying magic, and the ultimate goal is just to touch the threshold of the law.
But the road to immortality itself points directly to the laws of heaven and earth. If it is to understand the laws, why should Anton sacrifice the near and seek the far?
Even if you have to learn energy application techniques as a transition, magic is undoubtedly more worth the investment than magic.
The energy density gap between magic power and spiritual energy is enough to prove the disparity in power between the two.
What's more, on top of magic, there are also supernatural powers.
Moving mountains and filling seas, reaching for the stars and the moon, that is the true freedom and freedom.
No matter from any aspect, the magic and magical powers of the immortal cultivation system are superior.
Learning magic has no future.
Although he is still unable to practice magic at the early stage of Qi refining, his martial arts skills are no less than magic and are more worthy of his efforts.
Fortunately, learning magic itself requires spending a lot of time studying rune models and practicing spell casting. Only when you encounter difficulties do you need to consult a teacher.
Most of the time, Anton is relatively free.
I study hard during class on weekdays, and at other times I concentrate on refining spiritual energy, studying talismans, and practicing martial arts.
He had inquired in private that a three-layer warning system was deployed outside the Silver Moon Forest: song birds, sentinel trees and living thorns.
Songbirds are fist-sized emerald-feathered songbirds that emit calls at a specific frequency when they find strange alien creatures. The forest guards have special tools in hand that can receive the sounds made by songbirds and thus learn of the intrusion.
Living thorns are magical plants buried deep in the ground. They are usually hidden under fallen leaves and mulch. Once they sense an abnormal vibration or aura, they will rise up like poisonous snakes, twisting and connecting to form a vine wall several meters high.
Those barbed vines are as tough as iron and contain paralyzing toxins, enough to make intruders lose the ability to resist in the struggle.
If the enemy can break through the Living Thorns, the next thing they have to face is the Sentinel Tree.
The combat effectiveness of these activated trees is not as good as that of the oak guards, but they are superior in number. Each one has a white-position downstream combat capability, which is comparable to the elite soldiers of most town defenders. In many cases, they can successfully stop the enemy and buy time for the guards to arrive.
It is precisely by relying on this layer of defense network that the Forest Guard has successfully intercepted and repelled the invasion of the lizardmen many times.
If Anton wants to leave Silver Moon Forest, he will also have to face this dragnet.
Fortunately, he already had a rough plan.
"The Hide Talisman hides the breath, the Escape Talisman hides the figure, and the martial arts skills reduce the noise on the road... Well, it is safer to add a Light Body Talisman."
Anton calculated secretly.
With these means, it should be possible to pass through the warning net quietly and leave the Silver Moon Forest.
But before that, it will take some time to develop.
After all, the Scaled Rock Lizard is a dragon beast after all, and it is difficult to deal with it. It is better to wait until it has refined a bit more spiritual energy, mastered a few martial arts, and accumulated more talismans before going hunting.
This can be regarded as a player's instinct engraved in his bones. If he doesn't fully upgrade his skills and prepare enough supplies before downloading a dungeon, he will always feel insecure.
